Title: Public preview: Azure SQL Migration extension with Azure PowerShell and CLI support

Body.Content:
Leverage the Azure PowerShell module (Az.DataMigration) or Azure CLI commands (az datamigration) to assess and receive Azure recommendations. Migrate SQL Server databases at scale using the Azure Database Migration Service with the capabilities from the Azure SQL Migration extension for Azure Data Studio. Access the Azure SQL Migration extension capabilities with scripting and automation when handling migrations of multiple SQL Server instances to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines.

Learn more.
